scope: MuJoCo engineering transfer of the 302-neuron connectome with 48 inputs (24 exteroceptive/inertial + 24 proprioceptive) and 96 named muscles; not a measured organism or physics parity with Webots

mechanics.shape: 24 overlapping, tapered native capsule cuticle segments; massless annuli, quadrant landmarks and internal pharynx/intestine
mechanics.coordinates: X forward, Y ventral (+) / dorsal (-) for the side-lying worm, Z left; segment_00 tail to segment_23 head; muscle row r is on segment 24 - r
mechanics.self_contact: disabled; world contact enabled; cuticle collision geoms in group 1 (excluded from the worm's own range rays)
mechanics.limits: mass, shape, traction, motor gains and locomotion uncalibrated; no hidden supports
mechanics.skin: opaque illustrative cuticle avoids transparent capsule-overlap seams; no eyes; internal anatomical landmarks are schematic and may be occluded, not a connectome embedding
mechanics.substrate: resistive-force agar groove: per-segment tangential 0.01 and normal 0.2 N s/m (ratio 20); cuticle friction 0.02 with contact priority over the ground; a programmed 0.5 Hz / 0.65 L wave crawls at 0.16 L/s, the reversed wave backward
mechanics.calibration: mechanics v3 (2026-11-21): v2 damping 0.02 and 6 mN m servo tracked 28 % of a biological wave

muscles.names: MDL/MDR/MVL/MVR 01..24 (row 01 = head), MVL24 absent, separate MVULVA
muscles.transducer: celegans-muscle-v3-sim-v1: saturating twitch summation (0.3 per spike frame), 55 ms decay; each hinge driven by the two rows that span it; ventral minus dorsal mean activation; MVULVA does not bend the body; no left/right in-plane term
muscles.missing_packet: zero new muscle impulse; previous contraction decays; disarm after 100ms source-step age
muscles.zero_output: zero initial target/active effort; no injected twitch or gait

sensors.vibration: channels 0-2: rectified high-pass (tau 0.2 s) proper acceleration of segment_00 / 20 m s^-2 (a 12 m s^-2 plate tap reads 0.6; self-motion ~0.05) -> touch receptor neurons
sensors.rotation: channels 3-5: |body angular velocity| / 10 rad s^-1 -> DVA/PVD proprioception
sensors.touch: channels 6-7: head/tail object contact excluding ground and own body
sensors.fields: channels 8-20: analytic stimulus fields (scene.stimuli) sampled at amphid (nose) and phasmid (tail) mounts: light, temperature, soluble attractant, soluble repellent, volatile attractant, O2
sensors.range: channels 21-23: proximity rays 1-d/reach excluding every worm segment (geom group 1)
sensors.bend: channels 24-47: rectified dorsal/ventral hinge angle / 0.25 rad at 12 points head (01) to tail (12) -> B-type motor neurons, SMD/RMD, DVA
sensors.mounts: sensilla positions (v2); the Webots proto keeps the original 24 device mounts
sensors.noise: none (the App encoder adds its 1 %/8 % floor)

open_gates: Webots proto bend sensors (Webots keeps the 24-channel build)
production governed output commit and fencing
soil/agar traction calibration beyond resistive-force ratios

habitat.objects: shared lawns/colonies, food proxies, contact ridges, warm patch, cool refuge, light beacon, salt spot, repellent spot, copper ring
habitat.stimuli: volatile odour plumes and soluble food cues from the three lawns; salt spot; soluble repellent spot and ring; plate temperature gradient with warm patch and cool refuge; light spot; O2 depleted in lawns; plate tap every 15 s from 7.5 s
habitat.nutrition: not implemented; scene food objects do not grant metabolic energy
habitat.safety: no kinematic root, invisible support, new motor channel or scripted neural gait
